description.en: [PeriodO](http://perio.do) is a gazetteer of scholarly definitions of historical, art-historical, and archaeological periods. It eases the task of linking among datasets that define periods differently. It also helps scholars and students see where period definitions overlap or diverge.

other_download.title: PeriodO Period Gazetteer JSON-LD
other_download.description: This is a collection of period definitions found in academic literature. The data model is documented at [the PeriodO website](http://perio.do/data-model/).

other_download.title: Description of the PeriodO Period Gazetteer
other_download.description: VoID description of the PeriodO Period Gazetteer, including statistics on the current number of triples and links to other datasets.

other_download.title: PeriodO Vocabulary
other_download.description: PeriodO primarily uses the SKOS, Dublin Core, and OWL-Time vocabularies, but this proprietary vocabulary documents a few additional properties we needed to create.

other_download.title: PeriodO Period Gazetteer Change History
other_download.description: A log of all changes made to the PeriodO Period Gazetteer, published as JSON-LD using the [PROV Ontology](http://www.w3.org/TR/prov-o/).
